evidence.title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference

summary: Researchers have unveiled Daedalus-150M, a 150‑million‑parameter model that blends convolutional layers with transformer‑style attention to improve efficiency. The architecture is specifically engineered for fast inference on commodity CPUs, delivering performance comparable to larger GPU‑dependent models while lowering hardware costs.
title: Daedalus-150M Introduces Convolution-Attention Hybrid Optimized for CPU Inference
